known.title: Gate: update omitted-entry test expectations to low effort

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test.
Case: normal use - CI runs the existing role-default tests.
The `missing-claude-entries` parameter supplies `CODEX_MODELS`, so this condition expects xhigh for worker, coder, tester and refactorer. However, `src/forge/roles.py:86` selects `worker_models`, whose fallback is now low. The explorer assertion at line 75 has the same mismatch because absent explore settings fall back to lite. Also, `tests/test_subagent_roles.py:183` still expects medium for a Codex worker without a Codex build entry, which now receives low. These stale expectations fail against the intended defaults. Update the omitted-entry cases while retaining the configured-effort and design expectations.
